description: A photo-backed accordion styled like an OS launcher: the open item widens into a pill that reveals its numbered badge and a short line of copy, the closed items stay as slim title pills, and the photo crossfades behind — with a prev/next deck and counter in the corner, auto-play and full keyboard control.
interactionNotes: Clicking a pill opens it and clicking it again closes it. The deck in the bottom corner steps backward and forward, and the window-level keys do the same: ArrowRight/ArrowDown/S forward, ArrowLeft/ArrowUp/W back, Escape closes everything, and the number keys 1–5 jump straight to an item (ignored beyond the list length). Auto-play advances on its own interval and pauses while the pointer is over the card.

props.items: The accordion entries; `title` is the pill label, `badge` is the small index shown on the open pill, `claim` is the line of copy revealed under the title, `image` is the full-bleed photo shown while the item is open and `alt` is its alternative text.
props.staticImage: The photo shown while every item is closed — the resting backdrop behind the title pills.
props.defaultActiveIndex: The item open on the first render; pass `null` to start with everything closed. It only affects that render — later changes have no effect.
props.containerHeight: Height of the card in pixels, or any CSS height.
props.containerWidth: Width of the card in pixels, or any CSS width; the card never grows past its container.
props.autoPlay: Whether the open item advances on its own.
props.autoPlayInterval: Milliseconds between auto-play steps, clamped to at least 500.
props.pauseOnHover: Pause auto-play while the pointer is over the card.
props.onItemChange: Called with the open item's index whenever it changes, or `null` when everything is closed.

tips: Pills change size through real layout values, not scale transforms, so titles never stretch or squish and the card stays sharp on every frame.
Keyboard flow is window-level: arrows or S/W step through items, 1–5 jumps straight to one, and Escape clears the selection — make sure nothing else on the page swallows those keys.
Auto-play clamps `autoPlayInterval` to 500ms and pauses on hover; with `prefers-reduced-motion` every transition becomes an instant swap and auto-play turns off.
Feed real photos through `items[].image`; the shipped defaults are inline SVG gradient data URIs, so the component renders before any asset loads.
Under 640px the card stacks: pills go full-width and the nav deck keeps the bottom corner — check the counter's legibility over busy photos.
